detail.text: WARNING: BLEEDING RISK — BRILINTA, like other antiplatelet agents, can cause significant, sometimes fatal, bleeding. Also WARNING: ASPIRIN DOSE AND BRILINTA EFFECTIVENESS — maintenance doses of aspirin above 100 mg reduce the effectiveness of BRILINTA and should be avoided.

summary.text: BRILINTA was approved under a traditional (non-accelerated) NDA based on the single PLATO outcomes trial, after a prior Complete Response Letter (December 16, 2010) and an Advisory Committee that voted 7 to 1 for approval; approval required a REMS and the pediatric study requirement was waived.

citations.quote: The January 20, 2011 submission constituted a complete response to our December 16, 2010, action letter.
The ticagrelor NDA was presented to the Cardio-Renal Advisory Committee on July 28, 2010. By a 7-1 vote the committee recommended approval.

In accordance with section 505-1 of the FDA, we have determined that a REMS is necessary for Brilinta (ticagrelor) to ensure the benefits of the drug outweigh the risks of bleeding and loss of efficacy when co-administered with maintenance doses of aspirin \ge 100 mg daily.
We are waiving the pediatric study requirement for this application because necessary studies are impossible or highly impracticable.

description.text: Added indication to reduce risk of first MI or stroke in patients with coronary artery disease at high risk, established in type 2 diabetes mellitus population

description.text: Labeling revised to provide guidance on discontinuation of concomitant aspirin in CAD patients who underwent PCI

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for revisions to labeling to provide guidance to prescribers regarding discontinuation of concomitant aspirin in patients with coronary artery disease who have undergone percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).
